---
name: MCP Server Request
about: Request that a specific MCP server be added to the Pharos registry
title: "[SERVER REQUEST] "
labels: server-request
---

**Server name**
The name or package ID of the MCP server.

**Registry**
Where is this server currently published? (npm, mcp.io, mcp.so, Smithery, GitHub)

**What does it do?**
A short description of the server's functionality.

**Why should it be in Pharos?**
Why this server is useful to the PHAROS community.

**Link**
URL to the server's repo or registry page.
